title: Price Stability in the European Union: A Systemic Approach Using Random Matrix Theory
hypothesis: Monthly inflation indices of Eurozone countries as a 27 x 307 system are not randomly generated; eigenvalue spectrum via Marčenko-Pastur and Power-law fit reveals noise-dominated overfitting, Dragon-king spikes, and regional modular structures with self-organization.
sample: Monthly inflation rate variations (HICP / Consumption Price indices) for 27 Eurozone country members, matrix W = countries x time, no pre-processing or transformation
method: Step 1 - Data collection: Gather Eurostat monthly inflation rate variations for N=27 countries, T=307 monthly observations covering January 2001-July 2026 inclusive. Matrix W is T x N = 307 x 27. Abstract also prints 'January 2021 to July 2026' as period - Application section period January 2001-July 2026 with 307 observations is used. No transformations.

Step 2 - Wishart/correlation: Normalize W to tilde{W} and compute sample correlation matrix X = (1/N) * tilde{W}^T tilde{W}. Extract eigenvalues lambda_i. Ordered eigenvalues bar{lambda}_1 > bar{lambda}_2 > ... > bar{lambda}_n >0.

Step 3 - MP ESD and SETOL fit: Using WeightWatcher tool compute empirical spectral density (ESD) f(lambda)= N/T * sqrt((lambda_+-lambda)(lambda-lambda_-))/(2*pi*sigma^2) for lambda in [lambda_-,lambda_+] , 0 otherwise, where lambda_- = sigma^2*(1-sqrt(T/N))^2, lambda_+ = sigma^2*(1+sqrt(T/N))^2, aspect ratio Q=T/N. Log-log regression Power-law fit rho(lambda) ~ lambda^{-(a*mu + b)} to obtain lambda_-, sigma, information correlation alpha, and Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance D_KS vs theoretical Power-law. Select lambda_- achieving lowest D_KS.

Step 4 - Parameters for fit: Selected lambda_- =37.21, sigma=0.2, alpha=1.82, D_KS=0.10. Theoretical benchmarks: alpha ~2 = nearly perfect-fit, alpha in [2,6]= underfitting, alpha <2 =overfitting. lambda_- in [100,160]= perfect fit, lambda_- >200 = underfitting. These are parameters, not results.

Step 5 - Random benchmark: Compare empirical ESD to theoretical MP random ensemble max rand lambda_+^{rand} to identify spikes > lambda_+^{rand} as Dragon-kings / correlation-trap, not Gaussian outliers.

Step 6 - Pareto mapping: For overfitted case map alpha to Pareto shape mu via w_{i,j}(mu) ~ C/x^{mu+1}; rho(lambda) ~ lambda^{-(a*mu+b)} with a=1/2, b=1 for ideal alpha~2. Retrieved alpha=1.82 => mu=1.64.

Step 7 - Iterative stability: Compute condition numbers kappa_E(X)=sqrt(bar{lambda}_1/bar{lambda}_n) and kappa_D(X)=sqrt(sum bar{lambda}_i/bar{lambda}_n) iteratively: base estimation window 2001-2018 inclusive, then monthly additions 2019-2026 inclusive. Track kappa_E downward trend vs 2022 spike. Compute correlation between kappa_D and kappa_E series, and correlation of overall 2019-2026 sample with HICP.

Step 8 - NNSD denoising: Compute spacing distribution s_i=|bar{lambda}_i - bar{lambda}_{i-1}| for eigenvalues of X. Compute negative log-likelihood distances to P_GOE(s)= pi/2 * s * exp(-pi/4 * s^2) and P_Exp(s)=exp(-s) across correlation thresholds. Turning point where regime changes = cutoff 0.356. Clean correlation matrix keeping |corr| >0.356.
Step 9 - Clustering: On denoised X run Walktrap short random walks and leading eigenvector of modularity matrix Newman_2006 to detect communities. Report 6 communities. No other tuning printed.
